sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Fruit Collector is a simple yet addictive game that challenges players to collect fruits while avoiding bombs. The gameplay mechanics are straightforward: tap left and right to move the basket, collect fruits to score points, and avoid bombs to survive. Sounds easy, right? Well, it's not as simple as it seems. The game requires precision timing and quick reflexes to succeed.

One of the key mechanics that makes Fruit Collector so engaging is the limited chances you have to make mistakes. With only three chances to collect fruits and avoid bombs, you'll need to think carefully about each move. This adds a layer of complexity to the game, making it more challenging and rewarding with each level.

The game also features a scoring system that rewards players for collecting fruits quickly and efficiently. As you progress through the levels, the fruits will become more challenging to collect, and the bombs will become more frequent. Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Fruit Collector are simple yet engaging, making it a perfect fit for players who enjoy casual puzzle games with a twist.
